e2e_correlation_id_chain.description: Deterministic end-to-end forensic traceability linking every step of the offline inspection pipeline

pipeline_trace.description: Batch envelope tracking the mobile device synchronization session
Unique client-generated UUID per field action enforcing per-operation atomicity
Authoritative B.6 records (fault_cases, field_investigations, field_findings, field_evidence)
Chunked upload staging bound to domain finding and embedded in metadata_json
Monotonic sequence cursor recording authoritative execution receipt and payload hash
Downstream replication stream delivering hydrated domain entities matched by correlation UUID

adversarial_test_matrix.scenario: Offline complete lifecycle: Dispatch -> In-flight -> Arrival -> Investigation -> Finding -> Multi-chunk evidence -> Reconnect -> Push batch -> Domain execution -> Sealed evidence -> Delta pull -> Mobile reconstruction
adversarial_test_matrix.result: Domain state 100% consistent across all 7 layers; E2E Correlation ID validated end-to-end

adversarial_test_matrix.scenario: Push batch containing 1 valid operation and 1 invalid operation (mock location)
adversarial_test_matrix.result: HTTP 207 Multi-Status: Valid op ACCEPTED; Invalid op REJECTED; Rejection persisted via independent journal TX

adversarial_test_matrix.scenario: Replay of identical batch and individual client_submission_uuid
adversarial_test_matrix.result: HTTP 200 DUPLICATE: Resolved idempotently from cached receipt with zero duplicate domain rows

adversarial_test_matrix.scenario: Out-of-order chunk arrival, duplicate chunk deduplication, and hash conflict rejection
adversarial_test_matrix.result: Chunk 1 before Chunk 0 accepted; duplicate chunk deduplicated; conflicting hash rejected (HTTP 409); sealing succeeds

adversarial_test_matrix.scenario: Mid-upload connection loss (chunks incomplete), premature seal rejection, and resume upon reconnect
adversarial_test_matrix.result: Premature seal rejected (HTTP 422 CHUNKS_INCOMPLETE); missing chunk uploaded upon reconnect; assembly sealed

adversarial_test_matrix.scenario: Assembled binary SHA-256 does not match pre-declared target hash
adversarial_test_matrix.result: HTTP 422 ASSEMBLED_SHA256_MISMATCH: Staging files purged, zero domain rows created in field_evidence

adversarial_test_matrix.scenario: Device revoked by administrator prior to reconnect attempting push, upload, and pull
adversarial_test_matrix.result: Push (HTTP 403), Upload (HTTP 403), and Pull (HTTP 403) all blocked; historical journal preserved (B7-G19)

adversarial_test_matrix.scenario: Mobile attempts illegal FSM state transition (direct jump to CLOSED without findings)
adversarial_test_matrix.result: HTTP 422: Domain FSM rejects transition; rejection recorded in mobile_sync_journal via independent TX

adversarial_test_matrix.scenario: Ground truth separation: Field crew discovers fault on adjacent asset (#395) differing from FLI prediction (#394)
Delta pull after push, followed by concurrent journal append during client idle
adversarial_test_matrix.result: Subsequent pull with next_cursor receives newly appended operations with zero skipped records

adversarial_test_matrix.scenario: User A pulling with user_scope_only = true when operations from User B exist
adversarial_test_matrix.result: User A receives only User A's records; User B records remain strictly invisible

adversarial_test_matrix.scenario: Operations rejected during ingestion exist in journal
adversarial_test_matrix.result: REJECTED records remain server-only audit artifacts and are never streamed downstream to mobile

adversarial_test_matrix.scenario: Topology metrics measured before and after comprehensive E2E lifecycle
adversarial_test_matrix.result: Delta active translines = 0, Delta total translines = 0, Delta active assets = 0, Delta total assets = 0

adversarial_test_matrix.scenario: Replay of identical operations across independent executions
adversarial_test_matrix.result: Execution receipts, entity IDs, and journal sequences reproduce deterministically
